nodes.title: RSP
nodes.description: Repository-native engineering practice. This curated navigation model follows the Architecture Spec; relations describe responsibilities and dependencies, not execution order.

nodes.title: Workflow Skills
nodes.description: Seven distributed capabilities in skills/. A clear bounded request can invoke a capability directly. Core coordinates only when needed; relations are conditional responsibilities, not a mandatory stage sequence or agent topology.

nodes.title: rsp · Coordinate
nodes.description: Owns goal, scope, WorkOwner, capability selection and result acceptance when coordination or lifecycle work is needed. Direct capability calls need no Core preflight.

nodes.title: rsp-shape · Design
nodes.description: Provides read-only design advice or authorized executable Change/Group plans. Clarifies choices; the DecisionOwner retains approval.

nodes.title: rsp-implement · Build
nodes.description: Diagnoses symptoms read-only or implements authorized work and fixed-finding corrections, with ordinary self-checks. Those checks do not establish independent review.

nodes.title: rsp-doc · Write
nodes.description: Writes documents, Skills and release communication from settled facts; owns author checks and authorized record reconciliation, not product decisions or publication.

nodes.title: rsp-verify · Collect evidence
nodes.description: Collects a selected WorkOwner's declared check evidence read-only when requested or separately required. Reports pass, fail or unavailable; a pass is not semantic acceptance.

nodes.title: rsp-review · Judge
nodes.description: Judges a fixed change or bounded structural scope read-only, including supporting checks. Reports findings, clean or blocked; does not repair or approve.

nodes.title: rsp-commit · Deliver locally
nodes.description: Inspects readiness or performs one separately authorized exact-scope local commit. Lifecycle and remote delivery retain separate authority.

nodes.title: Maintainer-only Skills
nodes.description: Repository-local methods under .agents/skills/ for improving and evaluating RSP itself. These are not part of the seven distributed core capabilities and are not consumer runtime dependencies.

nodes.title: author-rsp-skills · Maintain
nodes.description: Audits or maintains authored RSP Skills, adding provenance, resource closure and evaluation requirements to Doc's authoring method.

nodes.title: distill-upstream · Research
nodes.description: Prepares upstream sources and investigates improvement opportunities with traceable evidence. Research does not itself adopt recommendations or change product behavior.

nodes.title: release-acceptance · Assess
nodes.description: Plans and interprets checks and Skill behavior evidence for an exact release candidate. Offline readiness does not establish model acceptance or authorize publication.

nodes.title: Repository contracts and work
nodes.description: Specs own stable contracts; Changes and Groups retain current work. CONTEXT provides navigation; archives and research provide historical evidence.

nodes.title: Domain interpretation
nodes.description: src/status, src/history, src/specs and src/architecture interpret repository artifacts and expose presentation-neutral projections.

nodes.title: Configuration and safe readers
nodes.description: src/core supplies configuration, filesystem boundaries and shared Markdown/YAML syntax reading.

nodes.title: CLI
nodes.description: src/cli and src/commands expose deterministic operations and public projections; observations do not grant semantic approval.

nodes.title: Terminal UI
nodes.description: src/tui presents repository state and owns interactive terminal lifecycle.

nodes.title: Architecture viewer
nodes.description: src/viewer provides an explicitly started local reading service, graph navigation and complete Spec reading.

nodes.title: Local reading service
nodes.description: service.ts, runtime.ts and documents.ts enforce workspace isolation, startup asset snapshots and current-link document access.

nodes.title: Graph and document UI
nodes.description: web/ renders sidebar navigation, object details and the full-document drawer; layout.ts adapts neutral selections through public LikeC4 APIs.

nodes.title: Host
nodes.description: Owns execution locations, workers, isolation, cancellation and resource lifecycle.

nodes.title: Git
nodes.description: Owns staging, history, branches, remotes, signing and integration. RSP does not infer delivery authority.

relations.description: When material choices or planning readiness are unresolved, select Shape and reconcile its recommendation or ready plan. The DecisionOwner retains approval; this is not a prerequisite for already-settled tasks.
Select Implement for authorized diagnosis, execution or fixed-finding correction. Core reconciles returned changes and evidence and owns any required correction/re-review loop.
Select Doc for needed authorized documentation, knowledge writeback or final-record reconciliation. Already-accurate records do not require cosmetic rewrites.

Select Verify for a requested declared-check result or separately required verification. Supply the selected WorkOwner, current target, check contract and execution authority; a returned pass is bounded evidence.

Select Review when requested, required or justified by concrete risk. Core validates findings and routes separately authorized corrections to Implement, then obtains required re-review. Required independence needs a distinct host-observed worker.

Only with separate local Git authority and applicable evidence, pass the exact delivery boundary to Commit. Necessary writing and authorized lifecycle actions remain upstream; commit success grants no remote delivery authority.

Substantive document or Skill writing and whole-Change convergence use Doc within existing authority. Ordinary local wording fixes and mechanical evidence updates do not force a separate writing pass.
Commit owns the exact local staging and native commit procedure, preserves hooks/signing and inspects effects. Git retains history and delivery ownership.
Delegation is optional and policy/authority dependent. The host supplies actual execution, isolation, liveness and cancellation; Core cannot invent worker identity or independence.
RSP-specific Skill maintenance applies Doc's Skill-authoring method and adds source provenance, resource closure and evaluation requirements.
A research recommendation is evidence for separately authorized design/planning when selected for adoption. Research itself does not create a Change or approve the decision.
Release assessment considers the exact authored Skill candidate and its applicable evaluation evidence; historical or offline results cannot stand in for missing current behavioral acceptance.
Skills apply stable contracts and retain authorized work and evidence in repository artifacts.
Capabilities use deterministic operations without delegating semantic acceptance or authority to command output.
The host supplies execution and resource lifecycle.
Git operations retain their separately authorized staging, history and delivery boundaries.
Domain queries interpret repository artifacts without becoming their contract authority.
Domain interpretation reuses configuration, safe readers and parsed syntax.
CLI commands consume neutral domain projections.
Terminal presentation consumes domain projections.
The explicit view command loads the viewing path and registers a workspace with a compatible local service.
The service obtains validated architecture and shared view selections independently of graphical presentation.
Document rendering reuses safe file access and Markdown parsing.
The browser reads authorized workspace models and full documents from the local service.
